property_summary: A play() call reverts if and only if the sent value is not exactly 10 wei, and on every non-reverting call the pot is either unchanged when the pre-call pot was zero or exactly the pre-call pot plus the ticket amount, while a winning call resets the pot to zero and still pays the fee from the pot before reset.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `play(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
